homePage.headerSubTitle: Below are your available Next Gen functionalities

TakeRegister.title: Registers
TakeRegister.description: Record lesson or session attendance or search for a register to complete.

PupilProfile.title: Pupil profile
PupilProfile.description: You can find a pupil's profile by entering at least two characters from the pupil's preferred name. Our advanced search will allow you to obtain basic pupil information and contact information more quickly.

PrimaryAssessment.title: Primary Assessments
PrimaryAssessment.description: Capture termly or half-termly assessments in reading, writing, and maths of pupils in year 1-6. View insights around class and year group performance and track pupil progress.

StaffProfile.title: Staff profile
StaffProfile.description: Search through all current staff members at the school and access their public profile.

SchoolManagement.title: Staff timetables
SchoolManagement.description: View your own timetable or other staff members’ timetables easily from the Staff Timetable Calendar.

AssessmentMarksheets.title: My Markbook
AssessmentMarksheets.description: A fast and intuitive new way for teachers to record their own assessments for the classes they teach

CustomGroups.title: Custom Groups
CustomGroups.description: Create, manage, and view your own customised pupil groups. All data syncs back to SIMS 7, ensuring effective monitoring and reporting of your groups.

ManagePermissions.title: Manage Permissions
ManagePermissions.description: View permission groups and their members, and easily edit the group permissions to meet your school's needs.

Seatingplans.title: Seating Plans
Seatingplans.description: Create room layouts and seating plans for your classes and lessons

Conduct.title: Conduct
Conduct.description: Create and maintain exclusions and suspensions.

NewHomePage.title: New Homepage
NewHomePage.description: Easily access information relevant to your role directly from the homepage. Sign up to become an early adopter for our first role-based homepage tailored for teachers.
